They can vote everyone down (and do it on the record), but they can't simply abdicate their duty by refusing to hold hearings. A filibuster would be acceptable, there are lots of silly procedural tricks that can be used to resolve tensions between the branches, once upon a time the President used to make "recess appointments" to get around the Senate refusing to schedule hearings, so then the Senate decided they would be perpetually in session.
